name: skill-craft-market
description: Multi-host marketplace adapters that pin skill-craft skills. Catalog only; skill SoT is whichguy/skill-craft.

plugins.name: skill-interop
plugins.description: Author or review portable multi-host agent skills (Grok, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes): prompt-first design, scaffold, install, marketplace facade.

plugins.name: prompt-audit
plugins.description: Audit an agent or skill prompt file for internal inconsistencies (phase numbering, contracts, terminology, stale references).

plugins.name: prompt-align
plugins.description: Compare an agent or skill prompt against its test harness for phase-model, skip-condition, and wiring consistency.

plugins.name: prompt-migrate
plugins.description: TDD-based prompt migration: write failing tests first, then update the prompt and commit atomically.

plugins.name: prompt-refine
plugins.description: Full prompt-improvement workflow: audit → remediate plan → migrate → align.

plugins.name: c-plan
plugins.description: Resolve ambiguous prompts: answer now, answer with assumptions, ask 1–2 high-value questions, replan, or stop.
